---
title: "Outreach"
---

I enjoy explaining how the brain learns to see to audiences outside the lab,
most often in science slams: short, entertaining talks for a general audience.
These talks are in German.

- **„Welchen Fernsehsender empfängt das Babyhirn?"** Geistesblitze-Science-Slam der
  Deutschen Gesellschaft für Neurologie (DGN), Volksbühne Berlin, März 2026.
  [Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qsCoXrlOMro) ·
  [Bericht](https://hirnstiftung.org/geistesblitze-science-slam-2026/)
- **Wie das Gehirn sehen lernt.** Kurzvortrag bei *Frankfurt hat Hirn*, einem
  öffentlichen Neurowissenschafts-Abend der Hertie-Stiftung, März 2026.
  [Bericht](https://fias.institute/en/news/news-publicity/how-our-brain-works-a-night-long-experience/)
- **Frettchen im Kino: frühe Entwicklung des visuellen Kortex.** Science Slam im
  Haus am Dom, Frankfurt, Februar 2026.
- **Wie das Gehirn die richtigen Akkorde findet.** Erster Oberurseler Science Slam,
  November 2025.
  [Presse](https://www.taunus-nachrichten.de/oberursel/nachrichten/oberursel/erster-oberurseler-scienceslam-vereins-kunstgriff-id216522.html)

## Interactive exhibit: EEG Mindball

Together with Bettina Hein, a former PhD student in our lab, I developed an *EEG
Mindball*: an interactive exhibit in which visitors try to move a ball by producing
a particular signal in their recorded EEG. It is modelled on an exhibit at the phaeno
science centre in Wolfsburg and offers a hands-on introduction to brain signals. It
has been shown at various events, such as the *Hessen schafft Wissen* exhibitions
(for example at the Frankfurt Book Fair), the FIAS 20th anniversary, the Night of
Science, and the FIAS booth at
[Frankfurt hat Hirn 2024](https://fias.institute/en/news/news-publicity/brilliant-knowledge-about-the-brain/).

## Panel discussions

- **20 years of FIAS**, anniversary ceremony, December 2024. Panel discussion on the
  role of FIAS and of interdisciplinary research, from a PhD student's perspective.
  [Report](https://fias.institute/en/news/news-publicity/a-ceremony-for-science-and-innovation/)

## Organising

- **[German Neuroscience Olympiad](https://neurowissenschaften-olympiade.de/team/#frankfurt)**, national final in Frankfurt, since 2019. Outreach
  and press contact, grading coordination, computational tutorial. The winner goes on
  to the International Brain Bee.
- **[Night of Science](https://nightofscience.de)**, the annual student-run science
  night on Goethe University's Riedberg campus. Member of the organising team
  2015 – 2018 and of the executive committee (Vorstand) in 2018, responsible for
  purchasing and for the concept of several booths.
- **[Bernstein Network PhD Symposium](https://fias.institute/en/news/news-publicity/successful-doctoral-symposium-of-the-bernstein-network-at-fias/)**
  "Transitions", held at FIAS after the Bernstein Conference 2024. Co-organised with
  Jonas Elpelt and Lisa Haxel.
